description: The proof pack of Proof-of-Done (plan task pod-29, docs/spec/agent-change-v0.1.md): the JSON-Schema validator (lib/proof/schema-validate.mjs), canonical JSON and the digest, the criterion status mapping from pod-16, pod-20 and pod-22 outputs, the reading of the inputs, masking and limits, and the rules beyond the schema (lib/proof/pack.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-pack.mjs.

mutations.name: PV-unknown-keyword-read
mutations.what: a schema keyword this file does not know is ignored instead of refused

mutations.name: PV-any-dialect
mutations.what: $schema may name another dialect

mutations.name: PV-defs-anywhere
mutations.what: $defs is accepted below the root, where references never look

mutations.name: PV-unknown-reference
mutations.what: a reference to a definition that does not exist is accepted

mutations.name: PV-no-loop-check
mutations.what: a loop of plain references is not detected when compiling

mutations.name: PV-type-repeats

patches.old: || new Set(list).size !== list.length) throw bad(keyword, `type is one of

mutations.name: PV-additional-schema

patches.old: if (value !== false) throw bad(keyword, 'only additionalProperties: false is supported');
patches.new: if (value === true) throw bad(keyword, 'only additionalProperties: false is supported');

mutations.name: PV-pattern-no-u
mutations.what: patterns are compiled without the u flag (\p{...} and code points read differently)

mutations.name: PV-proto-property

patches.old: if (FORBIDDEN_KEYS.has(name)) throw new SchemaError(join(join(at, keyword), name), 'bad_keyword_value'
patches.new: if (false) throw new SchemaError(join(join(at, keyword), name), 'bad_keyword_value'

mutations.name: PV-lone-surrogate

mutations.name: PV-forbidden-keys

mutations.name: PV-type-cascade

mutations.name: PV-integer-unsafe

mutations.name: PV-number-nan

mutations.name: PV-object-any

patches.new: case 'object': return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

mutations.name: PV-no-enum

mutations.name: PV-no-const

mutations.name: PV-min-length-off
